name: S. Korea
description: Known for bold, fiery flavors and satisfyingly chewy noodles, Korean instant ramyun has emerged as the worldwide packaged noodle of choice. UUDU's Seoul-ful lineup includes the iconic spicy umami of Shin Ramyun to Buldak's creamy, cheesy heat — plus other tasty options in between. It's plenty of options to indulge your Korean flavor cravings.

name: Japan
description: The birthplace of instant ramen brings refined, balanced flavors with premium ingredients. From rich tonkotsu to delicate shio broths, Japanese ramen offers sophisticated taste profiles that have perfected the art of noodle-making over decades.

name: Taiwan
description: Taiwan’s innovative noodle scene is represented by established brands like A-Sha and Surfmama—makers of premium wheat noodles enhanced by a wide spectrum of classic Taiwanese flavors, from delicate soy-based sauces to mildly tingling mala seasonings. Get ready to experience a whole different world of yumminess.

name: Other Asia
description: Explore diverse flavors from across Asia, including Indonesia’s beloved Mi Goreng, Thailand’s aromatic Tom Yum, and Singapore’s delectable curry. Each region brings its own signature blend of spices and cooking traditions—often inspired by a tropical sensibility that layers heat, citrus, herbs, and richness into every slurp.

name: Toppers
description: Instant noodles are just the starting point as the real upgrade begins with UUDU’s bold toppings. From classic veggies like bok choy and popular garnishes like Flamin’ Hot Cheetos to lip-smackin’ proteins like Korean mini smokies. Add sauces from Kewpie mayo to UUDU’s “rocket boosters” — our own house-made hack blends —, and suddenly the broth pops, the noodles hit harder, and any packet becomes a truly elevated bowl.

name: Sides
description: Golden egg rolls, bouncy fish balls, K-Spam Crunch, and popcorn chicken — hearty sides built to complement your bowl or hack right into it.

name: BÊV
description: Refresh your palate with drinks that complement your ramen experience. From Arizona teas and Jarritos sodas to Milkis, Mogu Mogu, and Topo Chico sparkling water — the perfect sip to go with your bowl.
